title: Get 2TB of lifetime cloud storage for a one-time $200 payment
content_html:
TL;DR: Pay $199.97 once for lifetime access to 2TB of FileLu cloud storage (reg. $600).

Credit: FileLu

$199.97
$600 Save $400.03

Cloud storage is useful, essential even. Paying for the same space every month is less appealing. FileLu offers another approach. Pay $199.97 just once and get lifetime access to its 2TB Premium Plan.

That makes this limited-time offer a practical choice for anyone ready to replace a recurring storage bill with one upfront purchase. The plan provides room for work documents, family photos, videos, creative projects, device backups, and more, with no limit on the number of files or folders you can store.

FileLu also gives experienced users plenty of ways to move data. In addition to web and mobile uploads, it supports FTP, FTPS, WebDAV, Rclone, URL uploads, a command-line interface, API access, and S3-compatible object storage. The FileLuSync app can schedule automatic folder backups from a computer or server, making the service useful for both everyday storage and longer-term protection.

Security features include SSL-protected transfers and encrypted storage. For more private material, Secure-SoloCypher Encryption lets users control the decryption key, while multiple folders can be protected with end-to-end encryption.

The plan works across desktop, web, Android, and iOS, so files remain within reach across devices. Global CDN support helps uploads and downloads move quickly, and FileLu places no speed or individual file-size limits on Premium accounts.

Families and teams can create shared spaces, collect files from others through FileDrop, share direct links, and allow comments on folders. Bulk folder downloads, multiple simultaneous downloads, email attachment backup, and ad-free links round out the package.

For buyers who know they will need cloud storage for years, paying once is a confident way to simplify the budget.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Don’t miss lifetime access to 2TB of FileLu Premium for a one-time $199.97 (reg. $600) for a limited time.

StackSocial prices subject to change.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR：一次性支付 199.97 美元，终身访问 2TB FileLu 云存储（原价 600 美元）。

图片来源：FileLu

$199.97
$600 Save $400.03

云存储很有用，甚至是必不可少的。 每个月支付相同空间的费用不太有吸引力。 FileLu 提供了另一种方法。 只需支付 199.97 美元一次，即可终身使用 2TB 高级计划。

这使得这种限时优惠成为任何准备通过一次预购来取代经常性存储费用的人的实用选择。 该计划为工作文档、家庭照片、视频、创意项目、设备备份等提供空间，并且对您可以存储的文件或文件夹的数量没有限制。

FileLu 还为经验丰富的用户提供了多种移动数据的方法。 除了 Web 和移动上传之外，它还支持 FTP、FTPS、WebDAV、Rclone、URL 上传、命令行界面、API 访问和 S3 兼容的对象存储。 FileLuSync 应用程序可以安排从计算机或服务器自动进行文件夹备份，使该服务对于日常存储和长期保护都很有用。

安全功能包括 SSL 保护的传输和加密存储。 对于更私密的材料，Secure-SoloCypher 加密允许用户控制解密密钥，同时可以通过端到端加密保护多个文件夹。

该计划适用于桌面、网络、Android 和 iOS，因此文件仍然可以跨设备访问。 全球 CDN 支持可帮助快速上传和下载，FileLu 对高级帐户没有速度或单个文件大小限制。

家庭和团队可以创建共享空间、通过 FileDrop 收集其他人的文件、共享直接链接并允许对文件夹进行评论。 批量文件夹下载、多个同时下载、电子邮件附件备份和无广告链接使该软件包更加完善。

对于知道自己将需要多年云存储的买家来说，一次性付款是简化预算的可靠方式。

混搭优惠

注册即表示您同意按照提供的号码接收来自 Mashable Deals 的定期自动 SMS 营销消息。 消息和数据速率可能适用。 每天最多 2 条消息。 回复 STOP 可选择退出，回复 HELP 寻求帮助。 同意不是购买的条件。 请参阅我们的隐私政策和使用条款。

不要错过限时一次性 199.97 美元（原价 600 美元）终身使用 2TB FileLu Premium 的机会。

StackSocial 价格可能会发生变化。
